**Safety parts we’ll add for a “Delete my account” button**

| Safety part | What it does | Why it matters |
|-------------|--------------|----------------|
| **Confirmation step** | The user must click “Yes, delete my account” after reading a brief warning. | Prevents accidental deletion. |
| **Server‑side deletion** | The delete request goes to a secure API route on your server; the Supabase service key stays on the server. | Keeps the key hidden from the browser. |
| **Delete only the user’s own data** | The server checks the logged‑in user’s ID and removes only rows that belong to them (and their files). | Guarantees no one else’s data is touched. |
| **Handle files** | Any files the user uploaded are removed from Supabase Storage. | Prevents orphaned files that would keep costing storage. |
| **Redirect after deletion** | After deletion the user is sent to a “Account deleted” page (or the home page). | Gives clear feedback that the action finished. |
| **Graceful error handling** | If anything fails (e.g. network, permissions) the user sees an error message and can retry. | Keeps the UI stable. |
